content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur, Punjab (HBCH) for filling various contract-based positions in their healthcare facility.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under HBCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts under this notification are Laundry Supervisor and Laundry Attendant, offering a total of 4 vacancies across these designations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for recruitment, categorized into 1 post for Laundry Supervisor and 3 posts for Laundry Attendant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an MCQ test if candidate volume is high, followed by a personal interview and a skill test to evaluate proficiency.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the announced positions is scheduled to be held on 27 October 2026 at the designated hospital premises.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for HBCH recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly walk-in. Candidates are required to directly attend the interview venue along with their resume and supporting original documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Laundry Supervisor?
faq.answer: Applicants must be graduates, and preference will be given to candidates possessing a degree or diploma in Hospitality or Hotel Management with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for Laundry Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) from a recognized board or university along with requisite laundry experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is up to 30 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, with relaxations provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 17,190 to Rs. 25,000 per month depending on the specific post, adhering to the institutional pay guidelines.
